changelog:
- Major release introducing three-layer storage, four core mechanisms, and a P0–P3 truth hierarchy for long-term memory management.
- Centralized MEMORY.md index (max 200 lines/25KB) as entrypoint; structured core JSON files and local LanceDB vector store for semantic search.
- Implements Engramory curation discipline, WAL protocol for write-ahead safety, context-aware working buffer, and automatic promotion of high-value memories.
- Maintains a strict truth source hierarchy: real-time data (SQLite state.db) for decisions; historical/session/log layers for analysis and learning.
- Maintenance scripts and deployment checklist updated to reflect new structure and core memory principles.
- Fully local and offline operation—no external APIs; pure filesystem, SQLite, and LanceDB.
summary: Three-layer storage + four mechanisms + P0-P3 truth hierarchy for long-term agent memory. MEMORY.md central index, memory/core/ structured facts, local vector DB semantic search. Engramory curation, WAL protocol, context management. Zero external API, pure local filesystem + SQLite + LanceDB.
